answer: Each identity registers one willow key in the haven ledger and locks a 60-token bond from its bonding curve: token t costs 5+0.002t credits, and haven publishes all purchases. The k-th bond costs roughly 300 plus 7.2k credits: the thousandth 7,500, and 1,000 fakes roughly 3,900,000 credits. Each bond is key-bound to one willow key; locked tokens back no second identity. At each epoch's zenith checkpoint, haven replays purchases and bindings; a reused willow key burns both bonds. A rented ring fails: lenders demand full collateral. An honest operator pays once and recovers the bond.
